page.title: Install blvm
page.lead: Pre-built binaries and Linux packages from GitHub Releases, with checksums.sha256 on every release. Verify before running.

packageSlots.label: Debian / Ubuntu
packageSlots.description: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 11+, and any dpkg-based distro. Installs the systemd unit and leaves it disabled.
packageSlots.installCmdTemplate:
sudo dpkg -i {{FILENAME}}
sudo apt-get install -f    # pull in any missing deps

packageSlots.label: Fedora / RHEL
packageSlots.description: Fedora 38+, RHEL 9, CentOS Stream 9, and RPM-based distros. Installs the systemd unit and leaves it disabled.

packageSlots.label: Arch Linux
packageSlots.description: Arch and other pacman-based distros (x86_64). Installs the systemd unit and leaves it disabled.

packageSlots.label: Linux x86_64
packageSlots.description: 64-bit Linux binary (glibc). Default release features. No package manager and no service unit.

packageSlots.label: ARM64 Linux
packageSlots.description: 64-bit ARM Linux binary (Raspberry Pi 4/5 with 64-bit OS, Apple Silicon Linux VMs). The binary only.

packageSlots.label: Windows
packageSlots.description: Portable Windows 10 / 11 build (64-bit). The download is the binary. The WinSW sample is in the blvm repository under contrib/init/, not in this download.

docker.title: Docker
docker.description: Image on GHCR for this tag. It runs as uid 61100 and stores data in /var/lib/blvm. RPC stays on loopback, so the command does not publish 8332. chown the host directory to 61100:61100 before the first start.
docker.runCmd:
mkdir -p blvm-data && sudo chown 61100:61100 blvm-data
docker run -d --name blvm --stop-timeout 240 \
  -p 8333:8333 \
  -v "$PWD/blvm-data:/var/lib/blvm" \
  ghcr.io/btcdecoded/blvm:{{VERSION}} \
  --network mainnet --listen-addr 0.0.0.0:8333
